title: Unit test agent report
description: Final structured report of the unit-test-agent. One entry per changed or targeted source file, findings about suspected product bugs, and the commands the agent ran.

summary.description: Two to five plain sentences: what changed, what was tested, what was skipped and why, final test status.

testsPassing.description: True only if the last full run of every suite the agent touched passed.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the source file the decision is about.

reason.description: Why this decision. For skipped files name the category: typesOnly, styles, story, barrel, entrypoint, config, docs, deleted, coverageExcluded, triviallyCovered, alreadyCovered, blockedByProductBug, budget.

testFiles.description: Repository-relative test files created or edited for this source file.

detail.description: Expected versus actual behaviour, and why the test was not changed to hide it.

evidence.description: How to reproduce: the failing assertion, test name or command.

summary.description: One line, for example: 14 passed, 0 failed, frontend lines 61.2%.
